name: Gwenis Dunmore
role: one of the Banked (Blood Hunter 3, Pale Moon, Crow); the Order's eyes
backstory: A Watchman lost to the burn after the Gallowsbird, Gwenis was Berserk in the Collarhouse cellar and was quenched in a lucid moment on day 3. Sharp-eyed in and out of her Crow form, she scouted the Saltgate, spotted Rook's man on the wall-walk, carried the Coal through the salt ditches and up the Dunmar Road, and stays at Dunmarrow with Kita and Ulric Vane.
wants: To keep the Coal's resting place secret and the hall standing.
fears: Going back to where the rage had her.
secrets: The Heartcoal lies in the Dunmarrow vault; she helped carry it there.
dm_only: Kinship between Gwenis and Kita Dunmore isn't recorded; ask the player.
